title: Zeros or X-Intercepts
text: The numerator is the nonzero constant $$3$$, so the function can never equal $$0$$.

title: Domain
text: The denominator is zero at $$x=4$$, so exclude $$x=4$$ from the domain.

title: Range
text: The value $$\frac{3}{x-4}$$ can never be $$0$$, but every nonzero real $$y$$ occurs for $$x=4+\frac{3}{y}$$.
